title: Turkish Kunefe with Smoked Lardons
description: A rich and creamy Turkish dessert featuring crispy shredded phyllo pastry, cheese, and caramelized sugar, topped with smoked lardons.

ingredients.name: Granulated Sugar
ingredients.notes: Caramelized sugar adds a rich flavor

instructions: Caramelize the sugar by heating it in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until it turns golden brown.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter and mix with the ground cardamom.
Cut the kunefe cheese into small pieces and set aside.
Layer the phyllo pastry in a baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter and water.
Sprinkle the kunefe cheese over the phyllo pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the caramelized sugar over the cheese and sprinkle with smoked lardons.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the phyllo pastry is golden brown and crispy.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for 5-7 minutes.
Optional: Fry some extra phyllo pastry strips in vegetable oil and sprinkle with powdered sugar for a crunchy topping.
